Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you reported
in Pearland, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just go by my first name for now, if that's okay.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were driving and what you were doing just before the collision?
A: I was heading east on a main road in Pearland, mostly stopped in traffic because the light ahead had turned red. I
had my foot on the brake and I was waiting for it to change.
Q: Did you notice the vehicle behind you before the impact?
A: Not really. I glanced in the mirror but it looked like it was slowing down too. Then there was a hard jolt from behind
and my head snapped forward and back.
Q: Did you feel any pain at the scene?
A: My neck hurt right away, but the bigger problem is my right shoulder. It felt like something tore or popped, and I
could barely lift my arm to the steering wheel.
Q: Did you seek medical attention?
A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic that same afternoon. They took x-rays and told me to follow up with an
orthopedic doctor because they suspected a soft tissue injury in the shoulder.
Q: Have you been able to return to work or your normal daily activities since then?
A: Only partly. I'm on lighter duty at the moment, and I can't do overhead reaching or carry anything heavy. Sleeping
is hard too because I can't lie on that side.
Q: Thank you. Is there anything you would like to add to your account?
A: Just that I was stopped and fully braking when it happened. I want that on the record.
Q: Understood. Thank you for your time today.
</page>
